scope: Device Control workflow rerun after cached inventory and background polling changes

phases.name: workflow
phases.assertion: The run still cannot reach the onboarding report because this host has persisted, currently available Android and Google TV transports; the zero-device onboarding precondition is therefore not present. No screenshot evidence was fabricated.

Dashboard background polling uses the cached snapshot; explicit re-probe and action refresh paths retain full probing.
supportingChecks: GET /api/v1/devices?cached=true returned in 9ms with only actionable cached rows.
GET /api/v1/devices completed in about 6.1s and refreshed the durable inventory.
Device Control UI: pnpm test (154 passed)
Device Control UI: pnpm type-check passed
Device Control UI: pnpm build passed
Device Control UI DashboardPage regression asserts the initial request uses cached=true

Live Windows, macOS arm64, GNOME Wayland, and KDE Wayland acceptance remains unavailable.
